graph.title: LEGO 7268-1 Crab
notes: The booklet is one page of small pictures, so many positions are best guesses. It builds one crab, not separate models.

Step numbering: main steps 1-7; the claw sub-assembly (booklet step 8 inset) is steps 8-11, built bottom-up in the order the pieces must be clutched (orange plates, black 2x3, red 1x2, then hinge p32); step 12 (the final booklet step 8) hinges the claw to p31 and adds no piece. The claw is modelled hanging below the hinge line so every plate rests on a piece under it; the booklet shows it the other way up.

The seven hinge joins (p31-p32 and six leg pairs p25-p30 with p19-p24) are real hinges (interleaved fingers), not stud joins, so those parts stay separate stud-groups in this model. They are listed in other_joins as hinge/hinge. This is the remaining 'separate groups' warning and is not a real gap in the build.

Fix: the lever bases p2/p3 have studs only (no anti-studs in the catalogue), so they cannot rest on a plate. They now sit beside the wedge level (p2 off the right edge, p3 off the back edge) and the side-handle plate p1 (right) and red 1x3 p16 (back) sit on top of them and on the wedge. So the levers are step 5 and p1/p16 step 6.
Fix: p11 now lies lengthwise on p4 only; p8 sits on p5 only, so no plate rests on three pieces.
Fix: p16 is back on the rear wedge (turn 90) and overhangs the lever p3. p14 now sits under hinge p32 (p32 rests on p14) because the taller hinge body cannot be rested on at a whole-plate layer.

Hinge plates under the 4x4 base are added after it, so their rests_on is []; they clutch the base underside (listed in other_joins). Leg distribution (left: claw + 2 legs; right: 4 legs) and the wedge turns are assumed.

graph_initial.title: LEGO 7268-1 Crab
notes: The booklet is one page of small pictures, so many positions are best guesses from the small images.

Step numbering: main steps 1-7; the claw inset sub-assembly is steps 8-10 (hinge+red plate, black 2x3, orange plates); step 11 (final step 8 of the booklet) attaches the claw to hinge p31 and adds no new piece.
Hinge plates are assumed to sit under the 4x4 base with studs up, clutching the base's underside. They are added after the base, so rests_on is [] for them and the join is listed in other_joins.
Leg distribution (left 2 + claw, right 4) is assumed; the picture does not show every leg clearly. Black legs are assumed to interleave their single finger with the red two-finger hinges.
The two red wedge plates are assumed to form a triangle pointing to the right, with the levers (antennae) on the free right-hand corners. Piece p1 (side handle) is assumed at the front of the layer.
The stud layout of layer 1 (p4, p5) and the orange/gray layer is inferred; the 'turn' values of the wedge plates are assumed.

final_issue_list: the build is 10 separate groups of pieces; connect them unless the booklet really builds separate models
p1 (Plate Special 1 x 2 Side Handle [Free Ends]) and p2 (Lever Small Base with Black Lever) fill the same space: check their column, row, layer and turn
p3 (Lever Small Base with Black Lever) and p16 (Plate 1 x 3) fill the same space: check their column, row, layer and turn
p16 rests on p3, but their placements do not join them: its bottom is at layer 4 but the top of p3 is at layer 4.70038
p1 rests on p2, but their placements do not join them: its bottom is at layer 4 but the top of p2 is at layer 4.70038
